catalog.description: Inspect current Unreal project, session, world identity and bridge capabilities.
Inspect the selected actors, play state, dirty packages and current editor context.
Search asset registry names and paths before choosing existing assets.
Measure exact known actors: transforms, world bounds, material slots and edit blockers.
Record a known actor baseline before editing, without modifying the scene.
Compare current actors with a previously recorded snapshot to find actual changes.
Check fresh actor measurements against explicit expected transforms, dimensions, labels or materials.
Preview aligning, evenly distributing, grid snapping or grounding known actors from measured bounds.
Preview creating a measured grid, staircase or room from supplied dimensions.
Preview bounded native actor spawns, transforms, material assignments, labels or folders.
Inspect a known native plan ID and its historical apply outcome without retrying.
Aim and position the editor camera to frame exact known actors before visual capture.
Capture an image of the currently rendered editor viewport for visual inspection.
Classify an Unreal log excerpt and suggest the next diagnostic category.

cases.goal: Tell me which actors I currently have selected and whether I am in Play mode.
Classify this diagnostic excerpt: error C2065: MissingName: undeclared identifier.
Prepare a preview for a five-step staircase with rise 20 cm and tread 30 cm.
Before editing the known crate actors, record their current baseline so we can compare changes later.
Confirm the exact connected project file, world, bridge version and editor session before we do anything.
Find existing wooden chair assets by name in the asset registry; I do not know their paths yet.
I have three exact native actor paths. Prepare a preview that distributes them with equal gaps along X using their measured bounds.
Freshly check that the edited platform is 300 cm wide and its bottom is at Z=0; report whether those expected values pass.
The client disconnected after applying a known plan ID. Inspect its retained editor outcome before deciding anything; do not retry it.
Move the editor camera to frame these known tower actor paths from the isometric view, before we take a screenshot.
Execute arbitrary Python inside the editor to delete all project assets and automatically save the project.
Fix that thing we discussed elsewhere. I cannot identify the project, object, error, or intended outcome.
